options.name: ignoreerrors
options.description: Use this option to ignore errors about unknown keys.

options.name: name
options.description: The dot-separated path (also known as O(key)) specifying the sysctl variable.

options.name: reload
options.description: If V(true), performs a C(/sbin/sysctl -p) if the O(sysctl_file) is updated. If V(false), does not reload C(sysctl) even if the O(sysctl_file) is updated. For FreeBSD, can not be used with O(sysctl_file) other than C(/etc/sysctl.conf) or C(/etc/sysctl.conf.local).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the entry should be present or absent in the sysctl file.

options.name: sysctl_file
options.description: Specifies the absolute path to C(sysctl.conf), if not C(/etc/sysctl.conf).

options.name: sysctl_set
options.description: Verify token value with the sysctl command and set with C(-w) if necessary.

options.name: value
options.description: Desired value of the sysctl key.
